reporting_rule: Report the exact sources, operations, observed results, unavailable checks, and limitations. Availability is not integrity, and no single score replaces the separate dimensions.
authority_boundary: Verification reports are non-amending. Only the three Bitcoin Originals have final version authority.
legacy_boundary: The old A/B/C modes and V6-V8 headline ladder are historical only and must not be inferred as the current verification model.
